title: A Phase III Study to Assess the Effect of FDC Laroprovstat/Rosuvastatin Compared with Rosuvastatin on LDL-C in Patients with Hypercholesterolaemia.
official: A Phase III Randomised, Double-Blind, Parallel-Group Study to Assess the Effect of Fixed Dose Combination Laroprovstat/Rosuvastatin Compared with Rosuvastatin on Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol in Patients with Hypercholesterolaemia.
summary: Main objective: To compare the effect of treatment with FDC laroprovstat/rosuvastatin versus rosuvastatin on LDL-C at 8 weeks
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participant must be ≥ 18 years of age
2. Participants must be on a stable dose of all background LLTs
3. The stable statin dose should be judged as their maximally tolerated dose
4. Participants should have either history of a clinical ASCVD event or be at increased risk for a first clinical ASCVD event
Exclusion criteria:
1. Asian origin
2. Uncontrolled severe hypertension
3. Uncontrolled T2DM
4. Inadequately treated hypothyroidism
